name: michi-neko-cadjs
description: Standalone, non-destructive Three.js CAD editor for Michi-Neko.

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "process.env.CADJS_VALIDATE='1'; await Promise.all([import('./server.mjs'),import('./src/catalog.mjs'),import('./src/agent-protocol.mjs'),import('./src/asset-package.mjs'),import('./src/kit-params.mjs')]); console.log('server/catalog/agent/asset modules: ok')" && npm test
